description.value:
You’re so immersed in divine scripture that you find meaning and guidance for any situation in your texts. Spend 10 minutes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Deciphering Writing} on religious scriptures of your deity or philosophy while thinking about a particular problem or conundrum you face, and then attempt a Religion check (DC determined by the GM).

If you succeed, you unearth a relevant passage, parable, or aphorism that can help you move forward or change your thinking to help solve your conundrum. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all skill checks relating to solving your conundrum until it is solved or your next daily preparations.

Once during the next 24 hours, you can use your Religion proficiency bonus when confronted with a skill check using another skill, as long as you meet any proficiency requirements for the attempt. If you use the intended skill, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus instead, or +4 if you critically succeeded the Decipher Writing check. Once you use this benefit, you cannot gain this benefit until your next daily preparations.
